VideoBookmark.title: VideoBookmark
VideoBookmark.description: Represents a saved video link item with AI classification, status tracking, and deletion lifecycle

url.description: Original URL of the video link

title.description: Title or summary of the video

source.description: Source platform of the video (youtube, instagram, tiktok, etc)

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the video was saved

status.description: Status of the saved video link

inTrash.description: Whether the video is currently placed in ClipSort trash

trashedAt.description: Unix timestamp when video was moved to trash

/videos/{videoId}.description: Saved video bookmarks collection managed by ClipSort
